thread:
alex: heads up — running our standard multilang smoke on paloma-compact-v1 (int6) and seeing odd bracket flips when Arabic is mixed with CJK in the same sentence.

maria: repro? sample?

alex: minimal repro: "你好 (مرحبا) 世界" -> model outputs closing bracket on the Arabic side instead of after the CJK. BLEU dropped ~3.5 on our small en-zh-ar test.

chen: whoa. is this tokenization or detokenization? could be bidi wrapping at postproc.

sofia: quick check — run detok-only on CPU with the same tokenizer artifacts pls, maybe q6 kernel changed subtoken boundaries.

alex: ran tokenizer dump, looks like a subtoken boundary moved. snippet:
```
input: 你好 (مرحبا) 世界
tokens: ["你","好"," ","(","م","رح","با",")"," ","世","界"]
paloma-int6: ["你","好"," ","(","مرحبا",")"," ","世","界"]
```

maria: paloma merged Arabic inside parentheses into one token? that would change offsets for bidi reordering.

chen: did we change the unicode-normalizer or token join heuristic in the tokenizer recipe for int6 quant build?

alex: build notes show we switched the merge-on-same-script flag to true for compact models to reduce vocab size. I suspected this might hurt mixed-script.

sofia: that flag explains the Arabic merge. For mixed CJK+RTL we want merge=false. can we test a quick canary with merge=false to see diff?

alex: canary run queued — command used: `./scripts/eval_multilang.sh --model paloma-compact-v1-int6 --canary --token-merge false --split small-mix`

deploy-bot: canary started (id=cb-6189). approx ETA 12m.

maria: also check detok step — if merged token spans parentheses, bidi algorithm may think bracket pairs are part of RTL run and mirror them. detok should preserve original unicode bracketing positions.

chen: adding quick unit: compare token offsets vs original string and ensure paired-bracket positions aren't moved by token merge. if violation -> fail.

alex: canary results (short): BLEU small-mix: base=29.1, int6-merge=true=25.6, int6-merge=false=28.9. chrF follows same trend. so merge=true is the culprit.

sofia: great catch. regressed by ~3.5 BLEU when merge enabled. For paloma-compact-v1 default config shouldn't enable cross-script merging. looks like the compact recipe override messed up.

maria: plan: revert merge override for compact models; add a regression test for mixed-script bracket pairs (small unit test + multilang smoke). also file a release note.

alex: will open PR with revert + test. pinging @chen for review on tokenizer change and @sofia for eval check.

chen: on it. also will add a quick postquant sanity that runs mixed CJK+RTL cases during quantization pipeline.

sofia: once PR lands, let's run a full-nightly on the larger suite to make sure no other side-effects.

alex: thanks everyone. logging a follow-up issue with sample inputs and canary id: cb-6189.

deploy-bot: canary cb-6189 completed — artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/canaries/cb-6189/report.html

maria: linking report in the ticket. next step: backport to v1-stable config and coordinate with release manager for a patch deploy to Dedicated staging. :thumbsup:
